title: WF03 f5 step04 issue-fix: ADM-UI env/test contract repaired; live OIDC browser reachability remains blocked
summary: Fixed the original ADM-UI blocker (missing BPM_E2E_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD handling) and aligned Admin Users frontend + tests so ADM-UI E2E now passes. Added deterministic prerequisite diagnostics for live OIDC login/logout tests. Remaining blocker is environment/browser inability to reach Keycloak authorization endpoint during cross-origin navigation.

root_cause.details: Initial failure was strict env var requirement in E2E. After unblocking, admin UI/test contract drift surfaced and was corrected in frontend/test code. Final blocker is OIDC live-browser network reachability to Keycloak auth endpoint despite local discovery checks.

changes: Updated web/tests/e2e/f5-admin-users.e2e.spec.ts to support deterministic admin credential defaults.
Implemented ADM-UI test contract support in web/src/pages/admin/UsersPage.tsx and route wiring in web/src/router.tsx.
Updated web/src/api/identity.ts create payload typing for username + role_ids.
Hardened web/tests/e2e/oidcf-login.e2e.spec.ts with deterministic Keycloak prerequisite error reporting.

commands.command: cd web; npx playwright test tests/e2e/f5-admin-users.e2e.spec.ts
cd web; npx playwright test tests/e2e/oidcf-login.e2e.spec.ts
commands.evidence: TC-OIDCF-03 and TC-OIDCF-05 fail with deterministic prerequisite error

prevention: Keep admin E2E selectors and required fields synchronized with the rendered admin users page contract.
For live OIDC tests, perform both API-level and browser-navigation-level prerequisite checks and treat cross-origin reachability as a hard environment gate.
